risks.description: Docker Desktop Linux VM baseline passed and the production gate now requires digest-pinned runsc plus a signed dedicated-host attestation, but dedicated real-Linux gVisor/runsc production execution is absent.

Local real-protocol Temporal, S3, physical PostgreSQL failover, encrypted backup/restore and Kubernetes pod-loss baselines passed; production mTLS Temporal, managed database/object-lock, multi-zone topology, sustained load and deployment-bound DR evidence are absent.
Industrial and energy paths have no physical or high-fidelity stage certificate signed by the required qualified reviewers.
Medical and sensitive-interaction paths lack signed professional, jurisdictional and live escalation acceptance.
Enterprise IAM issuer/audience/JWKS, workload mTLS CA, secret broker, authenticated browser acceptance and customer pilot are not configured or run.

OPA 1.19.0 previously ran from a digest-pinned official container with network disabled and passed 25 Rego tests, but that historical baseline is not evidence for the current WORKTREE-NO-GIT candidate; the current Rego gate remains NOT_RUN_RESOURCE_FREEZE.

The 164-test Rust workspace, warnings-denied Clippy, 53 Python tests, 33-migration double application and PostgreSQL adapter result are historical 2026-08-06 baselines, not evidence for the current WORKTREE-NO-GIT candidate. The current expanded 66-migration workspace has only lightweight static gates in this evidence refresh; full Cargo, Java, Vue and database validation remains NOT_RUN_RESOURCE_FREEZE.
The checked-in evidence bundle is not yet rebound to the exact clean signed immutable candidate commit/tag and verified approved remote provenance, so its release identifier remains WORKTREE-NO-GIT.
Model generation/stream/billing/DLP/residency, MCP/A2A, OPC UA/MQTT/Modbus and supervised physical writes have code-level gates but no passing real production endpoint evidence.
Customer release authority, real domain experts and independent auditor signatures are not provided; repository tests cannot substitute for these external approvals.
